Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy for Deutsche Verb

Deutsche Verb is designed as an offline learning app. It does not require an account and does not send your learning progress to a server.

Information we collect

The app does not collect personal information. Learning progress, selected language, theme preference, and local settings are stored on your device only.

How information is used

Local app data is used only to provide core features such as flashcards, filters, progress tracking, and statistics.

Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or share personal data. The app has no registration system and no learning backend.

Offline operation

The verb database is bundled with the app. Internet access may only be used when you open external links such as release pages, author links, or help resources.

Children

The app is educational and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes

If this policy changes, the updated version will be published on this page.

Contact

For privacy questions, contact the developer through the author website or project repository.
